## Course outline

This course is a practical guide to working with large-scale datasets. It introduces the ecosystem of
technologies for data storage, data processing and building machine learning models, using Python as
the programming language. The full course outline is in
[this document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EqQWTEXl59Ap_saIe8scv4XRI4uISrAQ/edit?usp=sharing).

## Prerequisites

- **Data analysis experience** in any tool (SPSS, Stata, R, Excel or Python): you know how to
  clean, summarise and model a dataset.
- **Some Python.** If you've mostly used SPSS or Stata, work through
  [Module 0](notebooks/00-intro-to-python/index.qmd) before the course starts.
- **Basic command line use** (opening a terminal, running a command, changing folders) helps with setup.
- **A laptop** that meets the requirements on the [Setup](setup.qmd) page.

Before the first session, set up your computer by following [Setup](setup.qmd).
